reports.name: Monthly Attendance Summary
reports.description: Comprehensive monthly attendance report showing present, absent, late, and half-day records for all employees.

reports.name: Department Attendance Breakdown
reports.description: Attendance metrics broken down by department with comparison to company average.

reports.name: Leave Utilization Report
reports.description: Tracks leave usage per employee including vacation, sick, emergency, and special leaves with balance remaining.

reports.name: Pending Leave Requests
reports.description: List of all pending leave requests awaiting manager approval, sorted by date applied.

reports.name: Weekly Timesheet Summary
reports.description: Weekly summary of regular hours, overtime, and total hours logged by all active employees.

reports.name: Overtime Analysis Report
reports.description: Analysis of overtime hours by department and employee with trends over the past 6 months.

reports.name: Shift Coverage Report
reports.description: Shows shift coverage across all departments with gaps and overstaffing indicators.

reports.name: Shift Swap History
reports.description: Log of all shift swaps and schedule changes in the current month.

reports.name: Workforce Headcount Report
reports.description: Current headcount by department, employment type, and status with year-over-year comparison.

reports.name: Employee Turnover Analysis
reports.description: Monthly turnover rates by department with root cause analysis and retention recommendations.

reports.name: Absenteeism Trend Report
reports.description: Tracks absenteeism trends over 12 months with flagged patterns and intervention suggestions.

reports.name: Payroll Discrepancy Report
reports.description: Identifies discrepancies between expected and actual payroll based on timesheet and attendance data.
